label: Learn the Basics
desc: The foundation of Python — syntax, data types, control flow, and built-in structures.

subs.label: Basic Syntax
subs.desc: Indentation rules, comments, print statements, and the Python REPL.

subs.label: Variables & Data Types
subs.desc: int, float, str, bool, None — and dynamic typing in Python.

subs.label: Conditionals
subs.desc: if / elif / else, ternary expressions, and truthy/falsy values.

subs.label: Loops
subs.desc: for loops, while loops, break, continue, and range().

subs.label: Type Casting
subs.desc: Converting between types: int(), str(), float(), list(), etc.

subs.label: Exceptions
subs.desc: try/except/finally, raising exceptions, and custom exception classes.

subs.label: Functions & Builtins
subs.desc: Defining functions, *args, **kwargs, and useful builtins like map(), filter(), zip().

subs.label: Lists
subs.desc: Mutable ordered sequences — indexing, slicing, list methods.

subs.label: Tuples
subs.desc: Immutable sequences — packing, unpacking, named tuples.

subs.label: Sets
subs.desc: Unordered unique collections — set operations, frozenset.

subs.label: Dictionaries
subs.desc: Key-value stores — dict comprehensions, .get(), .items(), .update().

label: Data Structures & Algorithms
desc: Classic CS concepts implemented in Python — essential for technical interviews.

subs.label: Arrays and Linked Lists
subs.desc: Python lists as arrays, implementing singly/doubly linked lists.

subs.label: Hash Tables
subs.desc: Dictionaries under the hood — hashing and collision handling.

subs.label: Heaps, Stacks & Queues
subs.desc: heapq module, collections.deque, and stack patterns with lists.

subs.label: Binary Search Tree
subs.desc: BST properties, insertion, search, and traversal algorithms.

subs.label: Recursion
subs.desc: Base cases, call stacks, memoization, and tail recursion patterns.

subs.label: Sorting Algorithms
subs.desc: Built-in sort(), Timsort, and implementing merge/quick sort.

label: Modules
desc: Organising code with modules, packages, and the Python import system.

subs.label: Builtin Modules
subs.desc: os, sys, math, datetime, json, pathlib, collections, itertools.

subs.label: Custom Modules
subs.desc: Creating __init__.py, relative vs absolute imports, __all__.

label: Lambdas
desc: Anonymous functions with lambda — usage with map(), filter(), sorted(), and functional patterns.

label: Decorators
desc: Higher-order functions that wrap other functions — functools.wraps, class decorators, stacking decorators.

label: Iterators
desc: __iter__ and __next__ protocols, itertools module, lazy evaluation.

label: Regular Expressions
desc: Pattern matching with the re module — compile, match, search, findall, groups.

label: Object Oriented Programming
desc: Python's OOP model — classes, inheritance, magic methods, and encapsulation.

subs.label: Classes
subs.desc: __init__, instance vs class attributes, @classmethod, @staticmethod, @property.

subs.label: Inheritance
subs.desc: Single/multiple inheritance, super(), MRO (Method Resolution Order).

subs.label: Methods & Dunder
subs.desc: __str__, __repr__, __len__, __eq__, __hash__, and operator overloading.

label: Package Managers
desc: Tools for installing, managing, and isolating Python dependencies.

subs.label: pip
subs.desc: The standard Python package installer — pip install, requirements.txt, pip freeze.

subs.label: PyPI
subs.desc: The Python Package Index — finding, publishing, and versioning packages.

subs.label: Poetry
subs.desc: Modern dependency management with pyproject.toml, lock files, and virtual envs.

subs.label: Conda
subs.desc: Package and environment manager from Anaconda — great for data science.

subs.label: uv
subs.desc: Ultra-fast Python package and project manager written in Rust.

subs.label: Pipenv
subs.desc: Combines pip and virtualenv — Pipfile and Pipfile.lock.

subs.label: virtualenv
subs.desc: Creating isolated Python environments.

subs.label: pyenv
subs.desc: Managing multiple Python versions on the same machine.

subs.label: pyproject.toml
subs.desc: The modern Python project configuration standard (PEP 517/518).

label: List Comprehensions
desc: Concise syntax for building lists — [expr for x in iterable if condition].

label: Generator Expressions
desc: Lazy evaluation with (expr for x in iterable) — memory-efficient alternative to list comprehensions.

label: Paradigms
desc: Python as a multi-paradigm language — functional, procedural, and OOP patterns.

label: Context Manager
desc: The with statement, __enter__/__exit__, contextlib, and resource management patterns.

label: Learn a Framework
desc: Web and async frameworks for building APIs, dashboards, and services with Python.

subs.label: FastAPI
subs.desc: Modern, high-performance web API framework with automatic docs and type hints.

subs.label: Django
subs.desc: Batteries-included web framework — ORM, admin, auth, templates.

subs.label: Flask
subs.desc: Lightweight WSGI microframework — great for small APIs and services.

subs.label: aiohttp
subs.desc: Async HTTP client/server framework built on asyncio.

subs.label: Tornado
subs.desc: Non-blocking network I/O and web framework.

subs.label: Sanic
subs.desc: Fast async web server and framework, built for speed.

subs.label: Plotly Dash
subs.desc: Build interactive analytical web apps in pure Python.

subs.label: Pyramid
subs.desc: Flexible web framework — scales from simple to complex apps.

subs.label: gevent
subs.desc: Coroutine-based networking library using greenlets.

label: Concurrency
desc: Running tasks simultaneously in Python — threads, processes, and async.

subs.label: GIL
subs.desc: The Global Interpreter Lock — what it is, why it exists, and its impact on threading.

subs.label: Threading
subs.desc: Thread-based parallelism with the threading module — I/O-bound tasks.

subs.label: Multiprocessing
subs.desc: Process-based parallelism — bypassing the GIL for CPU-bound tasks.

subs.label: Asynchrony (asyncio)
subs.desc: Cooperative multitasking with async/await, event loops, and coroutines.

label: Static Typing
desc: Adding type annotations to Python — improving code quality and IDE support.

subs.label: typing module
subs.desc: List, Dict, Optional, Union, Callable, TypeVar, and Protocol.

subs.label: Pydantic
subs.desc: Data validation using Python type hints — widely used in FastAPI.

subs.label: mypy
subs.desc: Static type checker for Python — catches type errors before runtime.

subs.label: pyright
subs.desc: Fast type checker from Microsoft — powers Pylance in VS Code.

subs.label: pyre
subs.desc: Type checker from Meta — designed for large codebases.

label: Code Formatting
desc: Keeping Python code consistent, readable, and style-guide compliant.

subs.label: ruff
subs.desc: Extremely fast Python linter and formatter written in Rust — replaces flake8 + isort.

subs.label: black
subs.desc: The uncompromising code formatter — opinionated, zero-config formatting.

subs.label: yapf
subs.desc: Yet Another Python Formatter from Google — highly configurable.

subs.label: Sphinx
subs.desc: Documentation generator — reStructuredText, autodoc, and Read the Docs.

label: Common Packages
desc: Essential Python packages for data engineering: NumPy, Pandas, requests, SQLAlchemy, and more.

label: Testing
desc: Writing tests to verify correctness — unit, integration, and property-based testing.

subs.label: pytest
subs.desc: The most popular Python testing framework — fixtures, parametrize, plugins.

subs.label: unittest / pyUnit
subs.desc: Python's built-in testing framework based on xUnit patterns.

subs.label: doctest
subs.desc: Tests embedded in docstrings — simple and self-documenting.

subs.label: tox
subs.desc: Automate testing across multiple Python versions and environments.

subs.label: nose
subs.desc: Test runner extending unittest — largely superseded by pytest.
